verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI review customization docs say custom rules let teams define explicit guidelines for Graphite Agent to follow when reviewing code, and comment exclusions let them say where it should not comment. AI Review customizations are also listed as a pricing-tier feature. That covers natural-language team rules, but nothing evidences AST-pattern rules or linked style guides, and nothing independent confirms enforcement quality. Missing for 10: AST/pattern-based rule support, linking external style guides, detail on how rules are authored and scoped, hands-on corroboration that custom rules are enforced.
